item.title: What’s changed under the new defamation act in Ireland?
item.description: THE Defamation (Amendment) Act 2026, with most provisions effective from March 1, 2026, significantly overhauls Irish defamation law to curb high costs and, notably, abolish juries in High Court defamation cases.
